form.label: Research queue
form.description: Every plate-shaped code the site couldn't name: codes missing from plates.csv, and codes it lists as UNKNOWN. Pick a row to research the code.

search.query: | inputlookup ptf_research | fields code status country note first_seen | rename country AS found, first_seen AS queued | append [search `ptf_needs_research` | eval in_list=case(event_type=="unknown_plate", "not in plates.csv", event_type=="lookup", "listed as UNKNOWN") | stats count(eval(event_type!="sighting")) AS lookups count(eval(event_type=="sighting")) AS sightings dc(src_ip_hash) AS visitors min(_time) AS seen_first max(_time) AS seen_last values(mission_role) AS roles values(plate) AS plates values(entered_via) AS entered_via values(in_list) AS in_list BY code] | stats first(status) AS status first(found) AS found first(note) AS note min(queued) AS queued sum(lookups) AS lookups sum(sightings) AS sightings sum(visitors) AS visitors min(seen_first) AS seen_first max(seen_last) AS last_seen values(roles) AS roles values(plates) AS plates values(entered_via) AS entered_via values(in_list) AS in_list BY code | eval status=coalesce(status, "new"), lookups=coalesce(lookups, 0), sightings=coalesce(sightings, 0), visitors=coalesce(visitors, 0), first_seen=coalesce(queued, seen_first) | fields - queued seen_first | lookup ptf_plate_codes base_code AS code OUTPUT country AS listed_as | eval listed_as=mvdedup(listed_as)
| where status=="new" OR status=="researching" | stats count
| stats sum(lookups) AS lookups | fillnull value=0 lookups

single.title: Sightings

search.query: | stats sum(sightings) AS sightings | fillnull value=0 sightings

single.option: with a place or a car

search.query: | where in(status, $status$) | eval rank=case(status=="new", 1, status=="researching", 2, status=="identified", 3, status=="added", 4, true(), 5) | sort 0 rank, -lookups | eval first_seen=strftime(first_seen, "%Y-%m-%d"), last_seen=strftime(last_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | eval plates=mvjoin(mvindex(plates, 0, 4), ", "), roles=mvjoin(roles, ", "), entered_via=mvjoin(entered_via, ", "), in_list=mvjoin(in_list, ", ") | eval listed_as=if(isnull(listed_as), "", mvjoin(listed_as, " / ")) | table code status found lookups visitors sightings roles plates entered_via in_list listed_as first_seen last_seen note | rename code AS Code, status AS Status, found AS "Identified as", lookups AS Lookups, visitors AS Visitors, sightings AS Sightings, roles AS Roles, plates AS "Plates seen", entered_via AS "Entered via", in_list AS "plates.csv", listed_as AS "Letters listed as", first_seen AS "First seen", last_seen AS "Last seen", note AS Note

html.p: Codes marked Identified, written the way plates.csv writes them: the code alone, then with each role letter. Add the rows on GitHub, then mark each code Added to plates.csv on the Research a code page.

search.query: | inputlookup ptf_research | where status=="identified" AND len(country) > 0 | sort 0 code | eval row=mvappend(code.",".country, "C".code.",".country." Consul", "D".code.",".country." Diplomat", "S".code.",".country." Staff", code."D,".country." UN Diplomat") | mvexpand row | table row | rename row AS "plates.csv rows"

html.p: Typos, state plates and photo misreads: logged, but not queued for research.

search.query: `ptf_events` event_type="unknown_plate" | `ptf_plate_parts` | where plate_shaped=="false" | eval entered_via=coalesce(entered_via, "not recorded") | stats count AS times values(entered_via) AS entered_via max(_time) AS last_seen BY plate | sort 20 -times | eval last_seen=strftime(last_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | rename plate AS Entry, times AS Times, entered_via AS "Entered via", last_seen AS "Last seen"
